motion.name: mobile-sidebar
motion.purpose: Show or hide the mobile navigation; respect reduced motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--accent, #1b5139); color: var(--accent-contrast, #fff); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #123c2a); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #3b8060); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A labelled field for patient input.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-input">Full name</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-input" type="text">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; color: var(--text-strong, #214835); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #cbd4c0); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #193c2c); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #3b8060); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation link
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 45px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--accent-soft, #e3eee0); color: var(--accent, #1b5139); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #e5e9d9); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #3b8060); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 18px 20px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #cbd4c0); border-radius: 13px; color: var(--text, #193c2c); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #52655a); font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Emergency reminder
components.description: Shows emergency guidance near patient tasks.
components.css: .ds-emergency { display: flex; gap: 9px; margin: 0; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--warning-border, #e0b44c); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--warning-bg, #fff6e0); color: var(--warning-text, #6a3e00); font-size: 13px; } .ds-emergency a { color: inherit; font-weight: 800; } .ds-emergency a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #3b8060); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A forest green and warm ivory interface with clear hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Keep light and dark modes in sync.
dos: Do use visible focus states and meaningful labels.
donts: Don't add decorative cards that add no information.
